title: AI Claims System at Kenya's Public Health Insurer Reportedly Rejected Legitimate Hospital Claims as Fraudulent
summary: Kenya's parliamentary health committee reported that the Social Health Authority, the country's public health insurer, used AI that wrongly flagged legitimate hospital claims as fraudulent. The findings included Matata Nursing Home in Homa Bay County. The committee linked unjust AI-driven denials to financial strain on facilities and recommended mandatory human review of flagged claims.
